info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Creditcard Applications Offer-v4-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Offer API facilitates the submission of credit card application offers. It allows financial institutions to create and manage offers tailored for potential customers, enhancing their credit card application process. This API is designed for banks and credit unions looking to streamline their customer engagement and improve conversion rates through targeted offers. Developers can use this API to integrate offer submission functionality into their applications, providing end-users with effective card solutions.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a new offer application for review. Ensure all required fields are completed and valid to successfully create an application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new offer application. It should include all necessary details required for the offer, following the specified schema.

202.description: The request has been accepted and processing will continue asynchronously.

CreateCreditcardApplicationsOfferRequest.title: Offer Request Body

requestId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: An optional reference number for the offer.

customer.description: The customer information related to the offer.

resource.description: The resource associated with the offer.

priority.description: Priority of the offer request, with lower values indicating higher priority.

amount.description: The monetary amount of the offer.

currency.description: The currency code for the amount specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required upon processing the offer.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the request was made.

channel.description: The channel through which the request was made, such as web or mobile.

recordIndex.description: Index associated with the record of this offer request.

CreateCreditcardApplicationsOfferRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for creating an offer.

Customer.title: Customer Information

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number of the application.
